title: Marvel Fanfare #16 1984 Sky-Wolf Cockrum Wraparound Cover Mignola Sub-Mariner
conditionDescription: Bright, clean covers with light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Marvel Fanfare #16 (September 1984), Marvel Comics. "Sky-Wolf!" by Marv Wolfman, Dave Cockrum and Joe Sinnott (World War II air-combat team), plus a Sub-Mariner story "A Fable" by Bill Mantlo and Mike Mignola. Dave Cockrum wraparound cover. Baxter paper, no ads, $1.50 cover price.

Condition: bright, clean covers with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
